parsedVerdict.reasoning: CatalogueService does the usual work of an application service. It takes injected domain ports (ProductRepository), coordinates the use case (look up, create the domain entity, save) and maps domain entities to DTOs. The duplicate-id check needs a repository query, so it belongs to use-case orchestration. Putting it here is normal application-layer practice, not a domain rule leaking out of the domain. Product construction is handed to the domain entity. The file has no persistence code (no SQL, ORM or storage calls), no transport or framework handling (no HTTP request or response objects or status codes) and no presentation formatting. AddProductContextDto is an application-level input DTO holding an optional requestId. It is not transport logic and is never used for transport behaviour. No ADR prose was given that would say otherwise.
